transcript: Last night my boyfriend paul and I went to see the swallow at the Spanish congress. A new york Hispanic theater is a new play by guillamplua that was inspired by the shooting at the ok nightclub in orlando in 2016. The play deals with the relationship between a music teacher and a new student. At first they seem to have nothing in common but in reality both are trying to heal from the loss of a person. Although he does not speak Spanish, there are translation machines for English speakers. The swallow was complex, touching and phenomenally performed by the actors. The work continues until May 12, so go see it and with that another preview for my collection.
